reason.service_state_unread: procd did not answer the daemon: the service state is unknown

restart.title: Restart the core?
restart.description: All devices will lose their current connections. Downloads and calls will be interrupted. The core will restart in a few seconds.

stop.title: Stop the core?
stop.description: Routing will stop. Devices on the network will lose internet access until the core starts again.
